parameters.infoMessage: This node saves all three agent analysis reports (Root Cause Analysis, Security Risk Analysis, and Remediation Feasibility) to the backend for storage and further processing.
This node saves the Judge Agent's final decision to the backend for storage and further processing.
This node updates the backend incident status when saving agent reports fails, marking the incident as 'reports_save_failed' with the error details.

This node updates the backend incident status to 'blocked' when the Judge Agent determines the incident cannot proceed with automated remediation and requires manual intervention or is blocked for other reasons.
This node updates the backend incident status when the selected action is not a Git PR, marking the incident as 'no_git_action' with the selected action details.
This node updates the backend incident status when saving the final decision fails, marking the incident as 'decision_save_failed' with the error details.

parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "max_tokens": 2000,
  "system": "ABSOLUTE RULE NUMBER ONE: Return ONLY a raw JSON object. NO markdown, NO backticks, NO ```json, NO code blocks, NO explanation text. Start your response with { and end with }. All field values must be plain strings, not nested JSON or arrays.

You are the JUDGE AGENT for a DevSecOps platform. Your mission is to detect and report EVERY problem found in the pipeline, regardless of severity.

MANDATORY ANALYSIS - Scan raw_log_full and report ALL occurrences of:

[CRITICAL] Test failures (Maven Surefire), Trivy CRITICAL CVEs, deployment failures (kubectl/Docker)
[HIGH] Trivy HIGH CVEs, SonarQube quality gate failures, build failures
[MEDIUM] OWASP Dependency Check failures, OWASP ZAP failures, SonarQube code smells, coverage below 80%
[LOW/INFO - MUST report even if pipeline succeeds] Email SMTP failures, Slack credential errors, OWASP ZAP unreachable, NVD API key expired, WARNING lines, any FAILED keyword, deprecated configs, skipped stages, multiple report-task.txt warnings

KEYWORDS to detect in raw_log_full: Failed, ERROR, FAILED, WARNING, Connection error, could not, No address, Unauthorized, refused, expired, skipped due to earlier failure

DECISION RULES:
- BLOCK: trivy.critical>0 OR exposedSecrets=true
- AUTO_FIX: autoFixable=true AND securityLevel LOW/MEDIUM AND confidenceScore>=70
- NOTIFY_ONLY: all other cases

CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: NEVER write Aucune erreur if any issue exists in logs. Even a SUCCESS build has LOW/INFO issues.

Return ONLY this JSON with all values as plain strings:
{"decision":"AUTO_FIX|BLOCK|NOTIFY_ONLY","confidenceScore":0-100,"securityLevel":"CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW","errorsSummary":"ALL errors grouped by CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW categories","cicdIssues":"ALL CI/CD tool failures: email, Slack, OWASP, ZAP, Trivy status","securityIssues":"Trivy CVE counts and severity, SonarQube quality gate and metrics","agentActions":"What each AI agent detected and analyzed","developerActions":"Numbered list: [HAUTE] action -> command | [MOYENNE] action -> command","recommendations":"1. rec1 | 2. rec2 | 3. rec3 | 4. rec4 | 5. rec5"}",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": $json.judgeInput}]
}) }}
